tools.name: search
tools.description: Search approved products on Neeed Directory, newest first. Returns at most 20 results with id, title and url. The id is the product slug; pass it to fetch for a plain-text card. Queries shorter than two characters return no results.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: One approved product on Neeed Directory by id, the slug from search or list_products. Returns its title, plain-text card, url and metadata including its website, category and pricing model.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category on Neeed Directory with its slug, name, approved product count and url. Pass a category slug to list_products to read its product cards.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Approved product cards on Neeed Directory, newest first, with optional query, category, label and tag filters. Returns at most 50 cards per page with a total count. Each slug is an id that fetch accepts.

tools.name: submit_product
tools.description: Without sign-in, saves a private draft listing on Neeed Directory and returns a claim link: nothing is published or charged until the maker opens it, signs in and submits. Signed in with permission to edit listings, submits the listing to the maker's account: Neeed's automatic check publishes it or

tools.name: my_listings
tools.description: Your listings on Neeed Directory, newest first: status, plan, badge, the admin's feedback when there is any, and the page to open. Pass a slug to get one. When next_page is a number, call again with that page for older listings.

tools.name: check_badge
tools.description: Looks for the Neeed badge on one of your Free listings' sites now and answers found, missing or inconclusive, with the markup to add. It records nothing: the maker presses Verify on the listing's edit page to make the link dofollow or bring a hidden listing back.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Edits one of your listings: name, punchline, description, category, pricing model or Twitter handle, under the dashboard's rules. Editing a listing that is not live sends it back for review; a live listing stays live. A rejected listing cannot be edited.

tools.name: upgrade_listing
tools.description: Returns a Stripe Checkout link that upgrades one of your live Free listings to Premium, with the price. Nothing is charged until the maker opens the link and pays in the browser.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, list_categories, submit_product · Private data: submit_product, check_badge · Public sink: submit_product.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, list_categories, submit_product · Private data: submit_product, check_badge · Public sink: submit_product

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
